title: Tutu Learns to Try
moral: Trying new things helps you grow.

scenes.summary: Tutu is a very careful turtle who avoids trying new things.
scenes.text:
Tutu the Turtle Who Was Too Careful

In a peaceful pond surrounded by tall grass, lived a little turtle named Tutu.

Tutu was very careful.

He walked slowly.

He thought before every step.

And he avoided anything new.

scenes.summary: Tutu refuses to join his friends because he is afraid of falling.
scenes.text:
“Come play!” said Riko the Frog.

“We’re jumping over stones!”

Tutu shook his head.

“What if I fall?” he said.

“I’ll just watch.”

So Tutu stayed by the pond.

scenes.summary: Tutu watches others having fun but remains too cautious to join.
scenes.text:
Riko and the others laughed and played.

They hopped from stone to stone.

Splash! Jump! Splash!

Tutu watched quietly.

“That looks fun,” he said.

But he was too careful to try.
scenes.image_prompt: animals happily jumping on stones while turtle watches from side, cheerful cartoon

scenes.summary: Tutu accidentally falls into the water and realizes he can float.
scenes.text:
One day, a strong breeze blew.

Whoooosh!

Tutu slipped and slid toward the water.

Splash!

“Oh!” Tutu gasped.

Tutu paddled his feet.

And guess what?

He didn’t sink.

He floated!

“I’m okay!” he said.

Riko smiled.

“See? You can do it!”
scenes.image_prompt: turtle splashing into water then happily floating while frog encourages, cartoon style

scenes.summary: Tutu gains confidence and starts playing with his friends.
scenes.text:
Tutu climbed out and looked at the stones again.

“Maybe I can try,” he said.

Step…

Hop…

Splash!

He made it!

Soon, Tutu was playing with everyone.

He laughed and smiled.

“I was too careful before,” he said,

“but trying made it fun!”

Being careful is good.

But trying new things helps you grow.

The End

story:
Tutu the Turtle Who Was Too Careful

In a peaceful pond surrounded by tall grass, lived a little turtle named Tutu.

Tutu was very careful.

He walked slowly.

He thought before every step.

And he avoided anything new.

“Come play!” said Riko the Frog.

“We’re jumping over stones!”

Tutu shook his head.

“What if I fall?” he said.

“I’ll just watch.”

So Tutu stayed by the pond.

Riko and the others laughed and played.

They hopped from stone to stone.

Splash! Jump! Splash!

Tutu watched quietly.

“That looks fun,” he said.

But he was too careful to try.

One day, a strong breeze blew.

Whoooosh!

Tutu slipped and slid toward the water.

Splash!

“Oh!” Tutu gasped.

Tutu paddled his feet.

And guess what?

He didn’t sink.

He floated!

“I’m okay!” he said.

Riko smiled.

“See? You can do it!”

Tutu climbed out and looked at the stones again.

“Maybe I can try,” he said.

Step…

Hop…

Splash!

He made it!

Soon, Tutu was playing with everyone.

He laughed and smiled.

“I was too careful before,” he said,

“but trying made it fun!”

Being careful is good.

But trying new things helps you grow.

The End
